title: Azure AI Search: Connect Your Site and Create Indexes | Orchard Core
description:
Site search needs an index to search in, and that index has to live somewhere. Azure AI Search is a search service in Azure that can hold the indexes of your site.

The Azure AI Search module connects Orchard Core to that service. You enter the endpoint of the service and a way to sign in, create an index of your content types, and manage it from the admin. The search service in the recording is a stand-in, so the addresses and keys on screen are examples.

In this video:
• How it works: indexes in a search service
• Enable the module
• Connect to the service: endpoint and authentication
• Create an index: a source, content types and an analyzer
• What goes into an index
• Edit an index: name, content types and default query settings
• Index actions: synchronize, reset, rebuild and delete
